title: ui-theme — one base UI theme: every control matches every other, a little more compact, better borders (Opus)

set.request: we need some ui themes? ... try improving the base ui theme. stay as minimal as possible, but a little more compact, better borders and styling. the default ui (for controls, buttons) should all match each other, and match the base font size, so don't change default sizing. but we do need some ui theme sizes? ... if we set --size to affect ui size, we don't have independent control, but often we could apply the size sparingly, to the proper ui panel, and be ok.
set.now: measured: eleven controls equal at every size, six roots crawled clean
steps: Measure today: every control's height, padding, border and family across the site
Count the control rules in framework.css and name the accidental families
Write the one control grammar (one height, one padding, one hairline, one radius, one ring)
Reach tabs.css and dropdown.css only where the grammar touches them
Build /framework/ui/controls/ and its theme child; register in the parent
Measure after: heights equal at --size 1, 0.75x in a size-small panel, at 1280 and 3440
Crawl six roots at four widths for console errors; screenshot light and dark

links.label: Controls — the one box, the three sizes, the site's button beside it
The grammar, and every before/after number

set.outcome:
**One box, every control.** A button, a link that acts like one, a select, a text field, a textarea, a disclosure summary and a tab are now the same rectangle: one height, one padding, one hairline, one corner, one fill, one hover. Measured in one row at 1280 they were 40.5, 36.6, 34.6 and 43.7px tall; they are **all 36.09px** now, and all 43.19px at 3440.

![the row, the three sizes, and the site's own button beside them](light.png)

**[The page](/framework/ui/controls/)** — the row, the size ladder, and the site's own button next to the base one. Detail one click down: [the grammar and every number](/framework/ui/controls/doc/grammar.md).

**The default size did not change.** The default control is exactly the base font size, and 36.09px is what an `input`, a `select` and a `textarea` already measured. What got more compact is everything that was fatter than them: the site's button 40.5 -> 36.9px, a tab 43.7 -> 36.1px. Padding went from two pairs (`0.25em/1em` for a button, `0.25em/0.6em` for a field) to one, **`0.2em/0.8em`** — a fifth off the button's on both axes.

**One knob, `--size`.** `.size-small` (0.75) / `.size-regular` (1) / `.size-large` (1.25) on a PANEL moves every control inside it and nothing else: measured 27.06 / 36.09 / 45.11px at 1280 and 32.39 / 43.19 / 54.00px at 3440 — **0.750x and 1.250x to three decimals**, because the height is a `min-height` in `em` with the border inside it. Sized by padding instead it lands at 0.79x. The paging toolbar already renders at 36.09px; adding the single class takes all seven of its controls to 27.06px.

**Better borders.** One hairline on every control: `--fill-a32`, 2.29:1 in light and the same alpha in dark. It replaces `--line` on buttons (0.15 alpha, flattened to #e6e6e6 by the skin — 1.15:1, invisible at 3440) and `--subtle` on fields (0.55 — a text colour, which is why a field looked twice as heavy as the button beside it). Fields also gain the corner they never had.

**The one thing still not matching, and it is not the framework's to fix.** `styles/layers/theme/lew42/lew42.css` gives `.theme-lew42 :is(button, .btn)` its own voice — `font-size: 0.8em`, 700, uppercase, `padding: 0.7em 1.4em` — at (0,2,0), which no flat selector in the base theme can reach. So a button on this site is still 0.8em and 36.89px against everything else's 36.09. **Deleting those five declarations is the whole fix**; that file is outside this task's fence, and the page shows the two rows side by side so the choice is a look, not a guess.

**Also fixed:** a 1px bug in `ext/tabs` — `framework.css`'s util `:last-child { margin-bottom: 0 }` cancelled the -1px that seats the last tab on its bar's rule, and because the bar stretches its items every sibling grew a pixel to match (37.09 vs 36.09 in one strip).

**Verified:** 27 pages at 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440 — zero console errors, zero horizontal overflow. The one 404 (`/framework/web/`, a declared child whose dir does not exist) is pre-existing and someone else's. Light and dark shots in this dir.

**Left, with reasons.** The skin's five declarations (fence). Rule count went 15 -> 19 and 40 -> 49 declarations rather than down: `:active`, `:disabled` and the three size words are behaviour that did not exist, and an inline anchor needs a box rule before `min-height` applies — the part that did collapse is four boxes, 3 rules and 14 declarations, into 1 rule and 10. `/framework/ui/words/` still quotes the old `--pad-control` literal (`0.25em 1em`) and its measured numbers in two places — one line for whoever owns that page. No `ghost` and no `danger` variant: only `.prim` and `.bg` exist and a word with no caller is shelf-ware. No bare `.chip`: six modules have a prefixed one and `css-scopes.txt` forbids a new unprefixed framework word.
